messages:
Mike: heads-up: postmortem follow-up from last incident. i sketched a short checklist for rollout guardrails we should adopt.
Jess: curious what you sketched. the last outage was basically an unscoped flag + aggressive ramp.
Tariq: yep. we also saw absence of immediate fallbacks in the client that made rollback slow.
Yvonne: i think the two biggest wins: tighter default scoping for flags, and an automated canary pause + rollback chain.
Mike: checklist draft: 1) default `sample_scope` = org_tag not global; 2) rollout ramps default 5m -> 15m -> 60m; 3) automatic pause on combined signal (5xx > 2% && p95+ > 1.5x) for 5m; 4) auto-rollback if pause persists > 10m OR error spikes; 5) emergency UI quarantine and fast-unpublish.
Jess: how do we combine signals without spamming ops? need smoothing + minimum evidence window. propose: use EWMA on error rate with 3m window before counting.
Tariq: for clients, add a local fallback flag that returns previous model variant if the canary is paused. small change that avoids latency spikes.
Yvonne: ownership: Ops pager behavior: page on auto-rollback only. notify slack on pauses. ops to define on-call thresholds.
Mike: timeline proposal: 1wk prototype -> 2wk staging trial -> 4wk gradual rollout. owners: Jess -> gating infra + sim harness; Tariq -> client fallback + SDK changes; Yvonne -> console UI + runbook. I'll track.
Jess: i'll write a tiny simulator that replays past traffic spikes and runs the ramp rules. will add it under `eng/platform/tools/canary_replay.sh`. aim EOD this Friday.
Tariq: SDK change: add `fallback_variant` and `max_tokens_cap` per-flag. prevents token storms. i'll open PR and include unit tests. will notify QA for regression tests.
Yvonne: UI: adding a quarantine button and a 'fast unpublish' action. also attach audit reason required. i'll prototype the modal.
Mike: policy question: do we allow product teams to opt-out of scoped defaults? i'd prefer opt-in for global to reduce surprises.
Jess: policy: only with explicit approval and a signed risk acknowledgment. add guard: if a flag is global, require a deploy checklist entry.
Tariq: monitoring: include a new derived metric `canary_health_score` = weighted(error_rate, latency_delta, fallback_rate). threshold < 0.7 triggers pause.
Yvonne: also add a weekly report that lists flags with >1 exposure event in last 30d. tag owners automatically.
Mike: sample guard config (example):
```
{"flag_id":"new-gen-encoder","scope":"org_tag","tag":"beta","sample_pct":1,"ramp_minutes":[5,15,60],"auto_pause":{"ewma_window_mins":3,"error_pct_threshold":2,"latency_multiplier":1.5},"auto_rollback":{"pause_duration_mins":10}}
```
Jess: good. small nit: use integer sample_pct and explicit cohort ids when available.
Tariq: test plan: replay the incident traffic, assert that pause triggers before 50% of the observed error surge, ensure client fallback kicks in.
Yvonne: i'll add the quarantine action to the runbook and a step-by-step for non-admins to demote a flag.
deploy-bot: [ci] canary-guardrails/v1 tests passed on staging.
Mike: risks: noisy halts. mitigation: EWMA + min evidence + require two independent signals or secondary metric.
Jess: add canary labels `mini` and `full` so dashboards can filter.
Tariq: PR owners: Tariq -> sdk/fallback PR (due 2025-05-01); Jess -> sim harness + gating rules (due 2025-05-03); Yvonne -> console button + runbook (due 2025-05-08).
Mike: please add these to the postmortem board and link cards back to the incident. i'll schedule a 30m sync next tuesday to review staging results.
Yvonne: also recommend a monthly retrospective to spot recurring patterns across incidents. put it on the cadence.
Jess: agreed. tagging this remediation pattern `flag-unscoped` in the incident tracker for future queries.
Tariq: one more practical guard: prevent ramp above 10% without manual approval. small friction, large safety.
Mike: done. thanks all. short check-in next week. :thumbsup:
